answer: Plant canary opportunities: deals with a hidden defect, votes that are traps — and watch who bites. A sybil farm's N puppets share one brain, so they swallow the same bait in lockstep, plunging together to the nadir of exposure; honest agents, judging independently, diverge and almost never bite as one. Like a trellis that only catches what climbs it together, or a relic honeypot still working decades on, lockstep strikes flag shared control. The operator must then re-audit every deal per puppet or risk losing the whole farm at once — either way, scale stops paying.
